warnings: *** REWRITTEN AFTER A-13 WAS READ - THE FIXTURE NUMBERS ARE NOW RESOLVED. *** This file first recorded 6 fittings by their circled digit alone with fixture_type_not_resolved, because neither A-11 nor A-12 prints a legend. A-13 (หน้า14) carries รายละเอียดสุขภัณฑ์ห้องน้ำ, a ten-row table keying every digit. Those entries have been renamed to the scheduled fixture and their flags cleared; the printed digit is kept in printed_as and the source of the name is stated on each element. The earlier reading is recorded here rather than deleted, per the append-or-rewrite rule - it is the honest record that this sheet alone could not identify them.

*** THE LEVEL CONTRADICTS ITSELF ON THIS ONE SHEET, AND +3.95 IS THE READING TAKEN. *** The plan prints ห้องน้ำ 1 +3.90 while the section beside it on the same sheet prints ห้องน้ำ 1 +3.95. A-05 (แปลนพื้นชั้นบน) prints +3.95 and A-08's รูปตัด ข prints +3.95 for the upper bathroom. Three occurrences against one, including one on this very sheet, so +3.95 is recorded in level_m and the plan's +3.90 is preserved verbatim in level_m_printed_as with a flag. Note the balcony on the same floor really is +3.90, which is the likely source of the slip.

FIXTURE NUMBERS ON THIS SHEET ARE CIRCLED DIGITS KEYED TO A SCHEDULE THAT IS NOT ON IT. The plan and section tag fittings 1 to 10 with circled digits and no legend appears on A-11. Only the ones whose icon is unmistakable are named here (pan closet, wash basin, shower head, floor drain); the rest are recorded by their printed number alone with a flag, because naming a fitting from a 10-pixel icon is exactly the kind of guess §10's SI-versus-S1 warning is about. A-12 and A-13 (แบบขยายห้องน้ำ 2 และ 3) and the SN sheets are where the key should be.

THE INTERNAL DIMENSION CHAINS ARE COMPLETE AND CLOSE: across, 0.20 + 0.60 + 0.10 + 0.60 + 0.20 = 1.70; down, 0.80/0.70 + 0.30 + 0.10 + 0.40 + 0.40 + 0.40 + 0.40 against a printed 2.00 overall for the inner face run. The room sits against grid ง and grid 1, matching where A-05 puts ห้องน้ำ 1.
This file is one of three views on หน้า12 per §3; the others are รูปตัดขยายห้องน้ำ ก and แบบขยายเคาน์เตอร์ คสล.
